sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: What's next for Dan Quinn?
sources.description: At the end of the first half of Monday night's game, with the Commanders down 20-3 and coach Dan Quinn going viral based on a lip-reading clip that was being widely interpreted as him not realizing it was fourth down (after a failed fourth-down play), it looked like Quinn was on track to get fired after the game.
